title: Internet Time Machine
description: Turns network-quality history into provenance-aware trends and optional user-triggered summaries. It demonstrates thoughtful data visualization and transparent handling of measured, imported, and synthetic data.

title: Electrical Troubleshooter
description: Guides users through a safety-first electrical decision tree for recording observations and choosing clear escalation paths. It translates practical engineering judgment into an inspectable, repeatable workflow.

title: Project Digital Twin
description: Maps a technical project's architecture into a read-only view that makes components and relationships easier to understand. It showcases systems thinking, documentation discipline, and maintainability-focused tooling.

title: Question Machine
description: A progressive learning-tree tutor with deterministic assessment and optional semantic feedback. The project demonstrates structured educational UX and a careful boundary between dependable core behavior and AI-assisted guidance.

title: Digital Life Dashboard
description: A local-first dashboard for organizing browser-held notes, preferences, and privacy-conscious personal insights. It demonstrates responsive interface design and useful features without unnecessary collection of personal data.

title: Diploma Notes
description: Helps Kerala Diploma learners reach syllabus links, lesson material, notes, and question-paper resources from one organized study platform. It demonstrates information architecture and accessible static-web delivery for a focused student audience.

title: Engineering & Software Tool Archive
description: Brings together 26 public, local-first tools for engineering calculations, diagnostics, documentation, privacy review, and technical decision support. The collection demonstrates breadth while clearly stating the safety and data boundaries of every hosted report.

title: Portfolio & Content Studio
description: A fast static portfolio paired with a GitHub-backed Content Studio and automated publishing pipeline. It demonstrates dependency-free front-end engineering, secure OAuth boundaries, and maintainable content automation.
